verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a REST API that lets you "access, create and manipulate your content." It publishes an OpenAPI 3.0 spec with an interactive try-it reference, an official MCP server, and a successor API generation with SDKs. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that the API reaches parity with the UI. Many UI features (templates, block references, daily notes, AI auto-fill, sharing, scheduled exports, task actions) have no documented API equivalent, and the Beta API is being deprecated. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-parity claim, documented API coverage of UI features such as templates, sharing, tasks, daily notes and exports, and independent hands-on confirmation of API breadth.
